# matia_destination (Resource)

A Matia destination asset - a connector Matia writes data to. A Snowflake asset created on a backend with multipurpose support is multi_purpose, and its credentials cannot be changed through this resource: recreate it with terraform apply -replace. Use matia_asset for new multipurpose Snowflake assets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "matia_destination" "example" {
  name = "example-snowflake-destination"
  type = "snowflake"

  connection_config = jsonencode({
    account   = var.snowflake_account
    database  = "STANDARD_DATABASE"
    warehouse = "STANDARD_WAREHOUSE"
    role      = "STANDARD_ROLE"
    username  = var.snowflake_username
  })

  connection_secrets = jsonencode({
    password = var.snowflake_password
  })
}

variable "snowflake_account" {
  type = string
}

variable "snowflake_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "snowflake_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_config` (String) JSON object with connector-specific configuration for the destination.
- `name` (String) The display name of the destination asset.
- `type` (String) The connector type (e.g. snowflake, bigquery). Changing this forces resource replacement.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) The authentication method for the connector (e.g. direct). Defaults to direct.
- `connection_secrets` (String, Sensitive) JSON object with sensitive connector configuration (e.g. passwords, tokens).
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the destination asset.
- `is_draft` (Boolean) Whether the asset is created as a draft. Changing this forces resource replacement.
- `tags` (List of String) Tag IDs to associate with the asset. Changing this forces resource replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The asset ID assigned by Matia.
